changelog:
- Initial release of jpeng-image-generator.
- Generate AI images using DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or Midjourney via API.
- Supports image creation from text prompts, image variations, and inpainting edits.
- Includes options for thumbnail/illustration generation and style presets.
- Simple command-line usage and environment variable configuration.
summary: AI image generation skill using DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or Midjourney API. Generate, edit, and vary images from text prompts.
